Case ID: 1094
Case Type: Chargeback Claim
Date: 2025-03-25
Handled By: Claims - Keisha Morgan
Customer or Requestor: Brandon Weiss
Title: Chargeback filed after confirmed replacement shipment

Issue Description
Customer's bank opened a chargeback for merchandise not received even though the original order had already been replaced under a prior support case.

Steps Taken
- Pulled the original case notes and confirmed a replacement had shipped after the first package was lost in transit.
- Collected proof of delivery for the replacement order and email confirmations sent to the customer.
- Reviewed concession history to ensure no duplicate refund had been applied.
- Prepared representment documents for the payment processor with tracking, delivery photo, and communication history.

Resolution
Disputed the chargeback with complete evidence and placed the account under review to prevent duplicate concessions while the bank investigation remained open.

Follow-Up
Risk Operations monitored the account for additional dispute activity during the following 30 days.

Reference Documents
- Refund Playbook v2
- Internal Wiki - Refund Questions
